worldFact.place: Darvaza gas crater · Door to Hell
worldFact.locationContext: Karakum Desert · Ahal Province, Central Asia
worldFact.fact: When Soviet drilling equipment collapsed into an underground cavern in 1971, geologists set the escaping natural gas alight expecting it to burn off in weeks. The 70-metre-wide crater, dubbed the Door to Hell, has burned furiously and continuously for over 50 years.
